## Text
When a contract has been broken, if a sum is named in the contract as the amount to be paid in case of
such breach, the party complaining of the breach is entitled to reasonable compensation not exceeding
the amount so named, whether or not actual damage is proved.

## In plain words
If a contract names a fixed sum payable on breach, a Malaysian court awards reasonable compensation up to
that sum, not automatically the whole sum. This is the rule on penalty and liquidated damages clauses.

## When it matters in an NDA or service agreement
A fixed amount "per breach" in an NDA, or a large sum for late delivery.
